mapper.select: select o.order_id, o.order_no, o.external_order_no, o.channel_id, cch.channel_code, cch.channel_name, o.shop_name, o.customer_name, o.customer_phone, o.customer_address, o.lease_start_date, o.lease_end_date, o.warehouse_id, o.return_warehouse_id, o.ship_due_time, o.return_due_time, o.create_time, o.rent_amount, o.deposit_amount, o.order_status, o.pay_status, o.time_effect_status, o.weather_risk_flag, o.priority_flag, o.source_text_snapshot, o.share_snapshot_json, o.source_order_id, o.version, o.remark, oi.product_id, oi.package_id, oi.sn_id, oi.accessory_item_ids, oi.quantity, c.customer_nickname, c.remark as customer_note, w.warehouse_name, w.city as warehouse_city, recipient_history.province_code as recipient_province_code, recipient_history.city_code as recipient_city_code, recipient_history.district_code as recipient_district_code, recipient_history.amap_city_code as recipient_amap_city_code, recipient_history.province_name as recipient_province_name, recipient_history.city_name as recipient_city_name, recipient_history.district_name as recipient_district_name from ry_business.ry_rental_order o left join ry_business.ry_rental_customer c on c.customer_id = o.customer_id and c.tenant_id = o.tenant_id and c.member_id = o.member_id and c.is_delete = 0 left join ry_business.ry_rental_order_channel cch on cch.channel_id = o.channel_id and cch.is_delete = 0 left join ry_business.ry_rental_warehouse w on w.warehouse_id = o.warehouse_id and w.tenant_id = o.tenant_id and w.member_id = o.member_id and w.is_delete = 0 left join ( select h.tenant_id, h.member_id, h.order_no, h.province_code, h.city_code, h.district_code, h.amap_city_code, h.province_name, h.city_name, h.district_name from ry_business.ry_rental_order_recipient_history h inner join ( select tenant_id, member_id, order_no, max(recipient_history_id) as recipient_history_id from ry_business.ry_rental_order_recipient_history where is_delete = 0 and used = 1 group by tenant_id, member_id, order_no ) latest_history on latest_history.recipient_history_id = h.recipient_history_id and latest_history.tenant_id = h.tenant_id and latest_history.member_id = h.member_id and latest_history.order_no = h.order_no where h.is_delete = 0 and h.used = 1 ) recipient_history on recipient_history.tenant_id = o.tenant_id and recipient_history.member_id = o.member_id and recipient_history.order_no = o.order_no left join ry_business.ry_rental_order_item oi on oi.order_id = o.order_id and oi.tenant_id = o.tenant_id and oi.member_id = o.member_id and oi.is_delete = 0 where o.order_id = #{orderId} and o.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and o.member_id = #{merchantId} and o.is_delete = 0 order by oi.order_item_id limit 1

select count(1) from ry_business.ry_rental_order_channel where channel_id = #{channelId} and status = 0 and is_delete = 0 and ((scope_type = 'platform' and channel_type = 'alliance') or (scope_type = 'merchant' and tenant_id = #{tenantId} and member_id = #{merchantId}))
mapper.insert: insert into ry_business.ry_rental_order (tenant_id, member_id, order_no, external_order_no, channel_id, shop_name, customer_name, customer_phone, customer_address, warehouse_id, return_warehouse_id, lease_start_date, lease_end_date, ship_due_time, return_due_time, rent_amount, deposit_amount, order_status, pay_status, time_effect_status, weather_risk_flag, priority_flag, source_text_snapshot, share_snapshot_json, source_order_id, version, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark, is_delete) values (#{tenantId}, #{merchantId}, #{command.orderNo}, #{command.externalOrderNo}, #{command.channelId}, #{command.shopName}, #{command.customerName}, #{command.customerPhone}, #{command.customerAddress}, #{command.warehouseId}, #{command.returnWarehouseId}, #{command.leaseStartDate}, #{command.leaseEndDate}, nullif(#{command.shipDueTime}, ''), nullif(#{command.returnDueTime}, ''), #{command.rentAmount}, #{command.depositAmount}, coalesce(#{command.orderStatus}, 'pending_ship'), coalesce(#{command.payStatus}, 'unpaid'), #{command.timeEffectStatus}, coalesce(#{command.weatherRiskFlag}, 0), coalesce(#{command.priorityFlag}, 0), #{command.sourceTextSnapshot}, nullif(trim(#{command.shareSnapshotJson}), ''), #{command.sourceOrderId}, coalesce(#{command.version}, 0), #{operatorId}, now(), #{operatorId}, now(), #{command.remark}, 0)
